title: Commerce
description: ISC Class XI Commerce (G.S.E. / Commerce) subjects as prescribed.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ISC Examination Year 2027 Regulations and Syllabuses - Commerce (subject code 857) (www.cisce.org).
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026 against the CISCE-copyrighted ISC Year 2027 Commerce (857) syllabus document with a CLASS XI section, read through its Scribd reproduction because cisce.org returns 403 to automated fetches, with the ISC 2027 regulations mirror hosted by sfcjhs.org as corroboration. Commerce is a standalone ISC paper, distinct from Accountancy (858), Business Studies (859) and Economics (856). Class XI prescribes Paper I Theory (80 marks, eight units) and Paper II Project Work (20 marks); all eight units with their marks are registered below.

sections.title: Commerce
sections.description: Eight theory units totalling 80 marks, plus project work of 20 marks.

chapters.title: Nature and Purpose of Business
chapters.blurb: Business activity and its objectives: the nature of business and the purpose it serves in an economy. Unit weight: 10 marks.

chapters.title: Forms of Business Organization
chapters.blurb: Sole traders, partnerships, companies, public-sector undertakings and cooperatives: the organisation, features and suitability of each form. Unit weight: 25 marks.

chapters.title: Social Responsibility of Business and Business Ethics
chapters.blurb: The social responsibility of business towards society and the ethical principles that govern commercial conduct. Unit weight: 5 marks.

chapters.title: Emerging Modes of Business
chapters.blurb: Emerging modes of business, including e-business, and how they change the way trade is conducted. Unit weight: 5 marks.

chapters.title: Stock Exchange
chapters.blurb: The stock exchange and its working, including the role of SEBI in regulating the market. Unit weight: 5 marks.

chapters.title: Trade
chapters.blurb: Trade: its meaning, forms and the channels through which goods reach the consumer. Unit weight: 10 marks.

chapters.title: Foreign Trade
chapters.blurb: Foreign trade and the documents used to carry it out across borders. Unit weight: 10 marks.

chapters.title: Insurance
chapters.blurb: Insurance: its meaning, principles and role in commerce. Unit weight: 10 marks.
